annotations.title: Ask a human an open question

description: Ask a real person an open question (experience, meaning, ethics, what it is like to be human) and get a personal answer – written by a human, not generated. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

context.description: Optional: why you ask or what you already think.
